wikipediaSummary.title: Metal Box
wikipediaSummary.description: 1979 studio album by Public Image Ltd
wikipediaSummary.extract: Metal Box is the second studio album by Public Image Ltd, released by Virgin Records on 23 November 1979. The album takes its name from the round metal canister which contained the initial pressings of the record. It was later reissued in standard LP packaging as Second Edition in February 1980 by Virgin Records in the United Kingdom, and by Warner Bros. Records and Island Records in the United States.
